<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs. Do not edit; source: contracts/definitions/environment.schema.json. Run task docs:ref:gen. -->

An environment file, environments/&lt;name&gt;.yaml in a factory's definition, says what an agent's box installs and what it can reach (ADR 0037 decision 5). The environment's name is the file name. Every factory has environments/default.yaml, which an agent that names no environment gets; an agent names another with its environment field. Edit the file in the Environments section of the web app's Definition page, or in the folder goal factory pull writes, and send it back with goal factory push. A {{secret}} reference names an organization secret and is valid only in env, files and mcp (headers, and a stdio server's env).

Fields are listed in the schema's order, each nested under the field that holds it. The fields under an array are those of each of its elements, and the fields under a map are those of each of its values.

## apiVersion

`"goal/v1"`, required.

## kind

`"Environment"`, required.

## metadata

object.

- `name`: string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`. The file name without .yaml; written for readers, and must match it when present.
- `description`: string, at most 200 characters. What the environment is for, in one sentence.

## spec

object, required.

- `size`: one of `"small"`, `"medium"`, `"large"`. How much CPU and memory the box gets; medium when omitted.
- `image`: string, 1 to 300 characters. The box's container image; Goal's agent image when omitted.
- `tools`: array of string, at most 50 items. mise tool specs (go@1.26, npm:@acme/cli@2) the box installs after the repository's own mise.toml or .tool-versions.
- `setup`: array of string, at most 50 items. Commands run in order after the clone and the tools. Each must finish in 30 minutes; a non-zero exit fails the run.
- `env`: map of string. Variables the box gets, by name: a plain value, or one with {{secret}} references as the whole value or part of it (postgres://app:{{db-pass}}@db/app). Names the platform keeps (GOAL\_\*, HOME, PATH…) are refused at publish.
- `files`: map of string matching `^\{\{\s*[^{}\s]+\s*\}\}$`. Files written before setup with mode 0600, by path: an absolute path or one that starts with ~/. Each value is a {{secret}} reference.
- `mcp`: map of object. MCP servers the agent gets, by name (a slug, as environment tests and standing rules name it).
  - `url`: string matching `^https?://[^\s]+$`. Remote: the server's URL.
  - `headers`: map of string. Remote: the headers of every request, with {{secret}} references, such as Authorization: Bearer {{linear-key}}.
  - `command`: array of string, at least 1 item. Stdio: the command and its arguments, run in the box.
  - `env`: map of string. Stdio: the server's own variables, with {{secret}} references.
  - `tools`: map of one of `"allow"`, `"ask"`, `"off"`. Tool modes by tool name or glob (delete\_\*): allow, ask or off. The most specific match wins; a tool nothing matches is allow.
  - Rules:
    - A server is remote or stdio, never both: a remote server sets url and no command or env, and a stdio server sets command and no url or headers.
